“A CCR Engenharia fez a compensação das emissões dos Gases Efeito Estufa dos escopos 1 e 2 geradas na construção do empreendimento Condomínio Regente e estes Gases tiveram o seu sumidouro, através de um Projeto que substitui uso de biomassa não renovável por biomassa renovável.”

TIM invested in offsetting a portion of the residual emissions arising from its operations, as documented in its 2023 Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Inventory, through the acquisition of carbon credits originating from a Renewable Energy project that uses biomass as fuel to power the kilns, aimed at the production of ceramics in the Northeast region of Brazil. This project not only contributes to reducing the environmental impact of GHG emissions, but also promotes sustainable economic chains.

TIM offset its residual direct GHG emissions associated with Scope 1, specifically from its operations monitored during the year 2025. This process is based on continuous monitoring, which generates the GHG Inventory in accordance with the GHG Protocol, and is part of a comprehensive decarbonization strategy within its ESG Plan.
